packageRules.description: Identity, payment and lint-schema packages never auto-merge, and never ride inside a group. The rules above auto-merge every patch (dependencies included) and every devDependency minor, which is the right default for the long tail but wrong for these three. groupName is nulled deliberately: better-auth 1.6.30 -> 1.7.1 auto-merged on green because it was folded into a grouped patch-and-minor PR, so the bump was never looked at on its own - automerge:false alone is ambiguous for a package sitting inside an auto-merging group, and ungrouping is what actually makes this rule bite. 1.7 queries the account model on a new issuer column that did not exist, so every Microsoft sign-in callback returned 500 for two days; nothing in CI exercises a real OAuth callback and sessions last seven days, so it stayed hidden. @biomejs/biome is schema-version-coupled - a bump needs a paired 'biome migrate' that an auto-merge cannot run, and a biome minor once broke the Lint gate on main for exactly that reason. stripe follows the same principle: identity and money bumps wait for a human who reads the changelog.
